items.node_name: 配乐 SC1 底层脉动（120 秒）
items.prompt: Instrumental cinematic thriller underscore for a found-footage trailer, no vocals, no melody. Built from an industrial freezer compressor hum: a slow sub-bass pulse at 50 BPM, low bowed double bass, faint radio static woven into the rhythm, distant metallic creaks. Cold, oppressive, restrained. Structure: 0:00-0:27 sparse and quiet, just the pulse and the hum; 0:27-0:46 tension rises, a ticking clock-like metallic pulse and low string drones join; 0:46-1:04 dense and urgent, heavier percussion hits and dissonant strings; 1:04-1:10 everything accelerates and rises to a peak; 1:10 sudden dead stop to silence; 1:12-1:28 only a faint cold drone and very soft sub pulse, fading to nothing.
items.note: asked for 120 s, delivered 138 s; re-cut into four pieces in tools/soundmix.py (quiet gaps found at 32.2-35.8 s and 102.4-104.0 s)
